conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: Can you tell me what happened the last time you saw Xiyuan?
Respondent: ...Before...
Respondent: When we went home together, we would go to the stationery store to buy candy for Xiyuan.
Respondent: But because Auntie hasn’t been going to the amusement park with us recently, Xiyuan hadn’t had any candy for several days.
Respondent: I told Xiyuan to stay there and not move, then I ran to the stationery store to buy candy for her.
Respondent: The stationery store is right next to the amusement park. You just have to climb a flight of stairs. It’s really very close.
Respondent: I was only gone for a short while. I ran there.
Respondent: But Xiyuan...
Respondent: ...was gone.
Respondent: I called her many times...
Respondent: But she didn’t come. Only Auntie came over.
Respondent: Auntie told me... not to tell anyone, not to say that Auntie wasn’t with us.
Respondent: She told me not to say anything...
Respondent: Like the monkeys we saw at the temple...
